title: Card Rarity Randomizer
description:
[h2]Every run, every card's rarity is shuffled.[/h2]
At the start of a run the mod swaps the rarities of cards inside each card pool. A Strike might be a Rare and Whirlwind a Common. A summary screen shows exactly what changed.

[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*]Each character keeps the same number of Commons, Uncommons and Rares; only which cards they are changes
[*]Rewards, shops and other rarity rolls follow the new rarities
[*]Fixed for the whole run and repeatable: the same seed gives the same rarities
[*]Basic, Ancient, Curse, Status, Quest and Event cards are left alone
[*]Pre-Run Toggle: One-click button on Character Select and Custom Run screens to turn the randomizer ON or OFF before embarking (locked once a run begins for run consistency)
[*]Card Library (Compendium) Hotkey: Press F8 during any run to instantly open the in-game Card Library and view all cards with their active shuffled rarities
[/list]

[h3]Good to know[/h3]
[list]
[*]Changes gameplay, so everyone in a multiplayer lobby needs the mod.
[*]Built for game version 0.111.0. A game update can break it until the mod is updated.
[*]No dependencies.
[/list]

Unofficial fan-made mod, not affiliated with Mega Crit.
